description:

Bluelight is a leading software consultancy dedicated to designing and developing innovative technology that enhances users' lives. With a steadfast commitment to delivering exceptional service to our clients, Bluelight excels in its focus on quality and customer satisfaction. Our mission is not only to create cutting‑edge applications but also to foster a collaborative and enriching work environment where each team member can grow and thrive. With a presence across the United States and Central/South America, Bluelight is in an exciting phase of expansion, continually seeking exceptional talent to join its dynamic and diverse community.

We are looking for a skilled individual to join our rapidly growing team at Bluelight. This position is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast‑paced, dynamic environment where everyone's opinions and efforts are valued and appreciated. You will have the opportunity to contribute to challenging and meaningful projects, developing high‑quality applications that stand out in the market.

We value continuous learning, personal growth, and hard work, offering a collaborative environment that promotes professional development. If you are passionate about software development and eager to be part of a growing software consultancy, we invite you to apply and join us on this exciting journey.

What We Are Looking For
  • 4+ years of experience with Laravel, specifically with Laravel 8 and above, demonstrating a deep understanding of the framework's architecture and capabilities.
  • Expertise in MySQL database performance optimization, with a proven ability to identify and resolve complex database bottlenecks.
  • Strong hands‑on experience in writing, optimizing, and debugging complex SQL queries, especially for applications handling large and growing datasets. This includes a thorough understanding of EXPLAIN plans, indexing strategies (including composite indexes), and query rewriting techniques.
  • Proficiency with database schema design and normalization/denormalization strategies to ensure scalability and data integrity, particularly for high‑volume transactions.
  • Experience with Eloquent ORM and Laravel Query Builder, coupled with a clear understanding of how these tools generate SQL and how to optimize the underlying queries for performance.
  • Experience working in complex large‑scale multitenant SaaS applications.
  • Solid experience with Laravel Authentication and implementing robust security practices in backend systems.
  • Experience with testing tools, such as Pest PHP and PHPUnit, to ensure code quality and system reliability.
  • Proficiency in designing and implementing robust, scalable RESTful APIs in Laravel, focusing on performance and data efficiency.
  • Experience with ReactJS is a plus.
  • Ability to take extreme ownership over your work. Every day is a challenge to ensure you are performing to the expectations you and your team have agreed upon, both regarding estimates and the general process.
  • Ability to identify with Bluelight's clients' goals and dedicate yourself to delivering on the commitments you and your team make to them.
  • A positive mindset and a can‑do attitude.
  • Forensic attention to detail.
Company Benefits
  • Competitive salary and bonuses, including performance‑based salary increases.
  • Generous paid‑time‑off policy.
  • Flexible working hours.
  • Work remotely.
  • Continuing education, training, conferences.
  • Company‑sponsored coursework, exams, and certifications.

Being a consultant in our team is a fun, challenging, and rewarding career choice. Your contributions are highly valued by clients, and the work you do often has a direct and significant impact on their business.

You will have the opportunity to work on a variety of projects for our incredible clients, which will accelerate your career growth. You’ll collaborate with modern technologies and work alongside some of the best professionals in the industry!

If you’re eager to be part of an exciting, challenging, and rapidly growing consultancy, we encourage you to apply.

A Turner & Townsend é uma empresa global de serviços profissionais com mais de 22.000 colaboradores em mais de 60 países. Trabalhando com nossos clientes nos setores de imobiliário, infraestrutura, energia e recursos naturais, transformamos juntos, entregando resultados que melhoram a vida das pessoas.

Descrição da vaga
  • Project Manager will take responsibility for end-to-end service delivery. To ensure that client objectives are met through the delivery of an effective service. Interfacing with the client and other consultants, at all project stages. Responsible of manage overall project cost, schedule and budgets as well as manage general contractor and other directly contracted vendors and consultants.
  • Responsible to review construction proposals and related pricing/scopes, correct and assess work-in-place, to approve capital expenditure spends, including the revision of cost estimates prepared by contractors and others within a client´s organization.
  • This professional will also be planning, organizing, scheduling, directing, and controlling the delivery of the project on time.

Responsibilities include but are not limited to:

  • Analyze, track, and effectively manage critical milestone activities to avoid schedule slip.
  • Run and lead client and other required meetings, presenting updates to the client at all project stages.
  • Identify the factors that influence construction costs and can monitor and report on this data.
  • Support engineering decisions relating to the project cost and budget while design-build changes take place during construction.
  • Review requests for payment.
  • Track and ensure equipment meet the project schedule
  • Record occurrence that might result in a claim - acting on the client’s behalf.
  • Advocate on the part of the client during disputes, disagreements, modifications, or change orders.
  • Coordinate and oversee scheduling consultant reviews on the project.
  • Review and approve final invoices, payment applications, retention payments.
  • Oversee and manage the transfer of the building operations to the client including all close out documentation and warranties.
  • Collaborative approach, be client facing, able to develop strong relationships, confidently present to clients and stakeholders.
  • Be assertive and detail orientated, identify potential issues early and raise them in the appropriate forum for resolution.
  • Demonstrable record of accomplishment in the delivery of relevant projects.
  • Advanced skills with spreadsheets, report writing and presentations.
  • Management experience, with ability to manage and lead team in delivering a commission and general line management.
  • Manage revenue, team resources and priorities to ensure that client expectations are met.
Qualificações
  • Fluent in English at a working level to lead meetings, prepare reports and written communication, do presentations and talk to clients and suppliers.
  • Availability to live and work in Salvador/BA.
  • Solid experience as a project manager in construction.
  • Engineering degree, architectural degree or any construction related degree is mandatory
  • Construction experience is mandatory.
  • PMI or equivalent certification is a plus
  • Microsoft Office tools is mandatory
Informações adicionais

Nossos profissionais inspirados compartilham nossa visão e missão. Oferecemos um excelente local de trabalho, onde cada pessoa tem a oportunidade e a voz para promover mudanças.

Queremos que nossos profissionais tenham sucesso tanto no trabalho quanto na vida pessoal e por isso promovemos um ambiente de trabalho saudável, produtivo e flexível que respeita o equilíbrio entre vida pessoal e profissional.

A Movida (MOVI3) é uma empresa de aluguel de carros que oferece soluções inovadoras em mobilidade urbana para todo tipo de necessidade. Com perfil inovador aliado a forte governança corporativa, atua tanto no varejo, com aluguel de carros, como no mercado corporativo, com a terceirização de frotas para empresas, além da venda de seminovos. AgileEngine is an Inc. 5000 company that creates award-winning software for Fortune 500 brands and trailblazing startups across 17+ industries. We rank among the leaders in areas like application development and AI/ML, and our people-first culture has earned us multiple Best Place to Work awards.

WHY JOIN US

If you're looking for a place to grow, make an impact, and work with people who care, we'd love to meet you!

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for a Sales Engineering Delivery Manager with 3+ years of experience to connect prospective clients and internal teams. You will lead discovery sessions, capture key details like timelines and budgets, and turn insights into clear, high-impact proposals. Strong knowledge of business strategy, the SDLC, and excellent communication skills are essential.

WHAT YOU WILL DO
  • Technical Discovery Call & Stakeholder Engagement:
    • Assemble Sales Support Engineering team, align them on preliminary information, following internal RACI procedures;
    • Lead the Technical Discovery call, showcasing outstanding interpersonal skills with the ability to build rapport and trust quickly;
    • Demonstrate in-depth knowledge of the SDLC—from ideation and inception, through discovery and development, to market release—to guide discussions and identify project feasibility;
    • Use consultative questioning techniques to uncover client pain points and business objectives, extracting and analyzing high-level requirements such as project timeline, budget constraints, technical skill requirements, and risk assessments;
    • Showcase strong presentation and storytelling skills, ensuring clarity and persuasion in all client-facing interactions, both during calls and via emails.
  • Proposal Development & Deliverable Creation:
    • Develop dynamic, visually compelling presentation decks and engagement proposals that clearly articulate service offerings, project scope, value propositions, and strategic recommendations;
    • Customize deliverables to reflect client-specific challenges and opportunities uncovered during discovery meetings;
    • Integrate technical insights with business strategy, ensuring that proposals account for both immediate deliverables and long-term client growth.
  • Team Buildout and Project Kickoff:
    • Act as the primary point of coordination among Sales, Recruiting, and Engineering teams, ensuring smooth hand-offs from initial engagement through team buildout to project kick-off;
    • Serve as a “concierge” for deals, maintaining fluid communication and alignment across functions to drive successful client onboarding;
    • Serve as a trusted advisor during pre-sales engagements by translating complex technical aspects into digestible, business-focused narratives;
    • Maintain a sales/consulting mindset throughout the technical discovery process, ensuring proposals align with targeted business outcomes.
MUST HAVES
  • 3+ years of experience in similar Sales & Delivery Management roles;
  • Exceptional Communication & Soft Skills: outstanding interpersonal skills with the ability to build rapport and trust quickly; strong presentation and storytelling skills, ensuring clarity and persuasion in all client-facing interactions.
  • UX & Presentation Design Acumen: solid grasp of user experience (UX) principles and design thinking, enabling effective discussion of digital product experiences; proven track record of creating high-quality, visually engaging presentation decks and proposals.
  • Technical Savvy & SDLC Knowledge: a deep understanding of the software development lifecycle—from conceptualization through to market release—and familiarity with agile methodologies; capability to discuss technical nuances without losing sight of the business impact, bridging the gap between technical details and strategic outcomes.
  • Analytical & Strategic Thinking: strong analytical skills to synthesize complex information, identify key insights, and recommend actionable strategies; ability to prioritize client objectives while balancing technical feasibility and business goals.
  • Team Collaboration & Cross-Functional Coordination: demonstrated ability to work effectively across multiple departments, managing internal communications as deals move from the funnel stage to the kickoff; capability to serve as a liaison, ensuring alignment and clarity among Sales, Engineering, and Recruiting teams.
  • Consultative Sales Experience: prior experience in a pre-sales, sales engineering, or technical consulting role, ideally within a digital software consultancy or similar environment; ability to quickly assess client needs and transform them into actionable insights and proposals.
PERKS AND BENEFITS
  • Professional growth: Accelerate your professional journey with mentorship, TechTalks, and personalized growth roadmaps.
  • Competitive compensation: We match your ever-growing skills, talent, and contributions with competitive USD-based compensation and budgets for education, fitness, and team activities.
  • A selection of exciting projects: Join projects with modern solutions development and top-tier clients that include Fortune 500 enterprises and leading product brands.
  • Flextime: Tailor your schedule for an optimal work-life balance, by having the options of working from home and going to the office – whatever makes you the happiest and most productive.

Com mais de 6 milhões de clientes e cerca de R$ 475 bilhões assegurados, somos especialistas no desenvolvimento de soluções personalizadas em seguros de vida e planos de previdência individuais e corporativos. title: Sr. Data Engineer
description:
*Native/Bilingual English is required for this role (read/written/spoken)


Please upload your CV Resume in English.


Monthly salary: $4,000 - $5,000 USD


Our partner is looking for a hands-on and entrepreneurial Data Engineer to build and own the data infrastructure across their growing portfolio of minor league teams. In this role, you will be responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining the customer data stack, ensuring data is leveraged to enhance fan experience and drive revenue growth across their teams.


As the first data hire within the organization, you will operate with a high degree of autonomy while collaborating with a third-party systems integrator. You will report directly to the COO and work cross-functionally with operations, marketing, and local team General Managers. This is a compelling opportunity for a data professional who is excited to build from the ground up, take on diverse responsibilities in a startup environment, and apply their expertise in the sports industry.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Design, implement, and manage the company’s data infrastructure, including pipelines, ETL, and data warehouse (Google BigQuery). 
  • Build and maintain a customer data stack leveraging composable CDP, ETL, reverse ETL, fan journey tools (e.g., Braze, Iterable, Attentive) and modeling tools (e.g., Python).
  • Integrate data across ticketing systems, concessions and merchandising POS systems, CRM, BI platforms, and ETL tools to create a single source of truth for fan and business data. 
  • Leverage AI tools for tech stack development, maintenance, and sales/marketing analysis. 
  • Collaborate with local and centralized business teams to identify data-driven opportunities that improve fan engagement and revenue growth. 
  • Work with third-party systems integrators while independently owning day-to-day data operations. 
  • Ensure data quality, governance, and security across all systems. 
  • Contribute to the evaluation of future tools and modeling capabilities.


Qualifications & Skills:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or related field.
  • 5–8 years of hands-on data engineering experience, ideally in a high-growth or startup environment. 
  • Proficiency with Google BigQuery and experience with modern data stack tools (ETL, BI, CDP, reverse ETL). 
  • Familiarity with CRMs (Salesforce, HubSpot), BI platforms (Looker, Tableau, Metabase), and tools like Fivetran, dbt, Hightouch, Iterable, or Braze. 
  • Strong SQL skills; Python experience is a plus. 
  • Entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to thrive in ambiguity and operate independently.
  • Strong communicator to collaborate with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Background in sports is preferred but not required. 


What We Offer:

  • Two weeks of paid vacation per year.
  • 10 paid days for local holidays.
  • Career development and growth opportunities in a dynamic startup environment.
  • A unique opportunity to build data infrastructure from the ground up and have a direct impact on fan experience and revenue growth. 
  • Entrepreneurial, collaborative, and flexible work culture.

title: Agile Coach
description:
Estamos em busca de um Agile Coach para ser o agente catalisador da transformação ágil em nossa organização. Essa pessoa terá papel fundamental na construção dos fundamentos culturais, comportamentais e operacionais necessários para evoluir da execução tradicional para a entrega contínua de valor ao cliente.


O que você fará

  • Conduzir trilhas de capacitação sobre agilidade (mindset, papéis, cerimônias e princípios do Manifesto Ágil);
  • Apoiar a implementação inicial de frameworks e métodos (Scrum, Kanban, SAFe ou híbridos), respeitando o contexto e ritmo do time;
  • Desenvolver workshops e dinâmicas para fortalecer cultura, propósito e colaboração;
  • Facilitar retrospectivas, reviews e plannings junto ao Product Owner e líderes técnicos;
  • Criar métricas de evolução ágil (ex.: Lead Time, Cycle Time);
  • Apoiar comunidades de prática e disseminar a cultura ágil em toda a organização;
  • Atuar como elo entre times de produto, tecnologia e negócio, garantindo foco em valor e aprendizado contínuo.


Perfil que buscamos

  • Habilidade de escuta ativa, empatia e comunicação não violenta;
  • Capacidade de traduzir conceitos complexos de forma simples e inspiradora;
  • Experiência em mudança cultural e gestão de conflitos;
  • Resiliência para construir do zero em ambientes com baixa maturidade ágil;
  • Visão sistêmica e pensamento orientado a produto.

title: iGaming Game Designer
description:
Game Designer – Cassino Online (iGaming)


Remoto | PJ | 40 horas | Slots e outros jogos de cassino


Na RapidPlay Games, queremos alguém que crie jogos de cassino incríveis : visualmente bonitos, matematicamente sólidos, psicologicamente envolventes e com um toque de inovação em IA. Se você adora investigar como os jogos “funcionam por dentro”, curte tendências de player behaviour e tem espírito empreendedor e positivo, você vai se encaixar muito bem no nosso time.

title: Ruby on Rails Developer
description:
About You

You are a back-end engineer passionate about building scalable, reliable, and maintainable applications. You thrive on writing clean code, applying modern architecture patterns, and leveraging cloud-based solutions. You enjoy solving complex challenges, automating infrastructure, and ensuring that systems are secure, performant, and ready to scale. You’re looking for a company where you can keep growing professionally and directly influence technical excellence.


You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field; or equivalent professional experience.
  • 5+ years of experience in back-end development using Ruby on Rails.
  • Strong experience with AWS services such as Lambda, EC2, S3, RDS, and API Gateway.
  • Hands-on experience using Terraform for Infrastructure as Code (IaC) deployments.
  • Solid understanding of serverless architectures and AWS Lambda functions.
  • Experience designing and consuming RESTful and GraphQL APIs.
  • Knowledge of PostgreSQL, Redis, and background job frameworks (Sidekiq, Resque).
  • Familiarity with Docker, CI/CD pipelines, and automated deployments.
  • Experience working with Agile/Scrum methodologies, and proficiency using Jira and Confluence for project tracking.
  • Strong debugging, problem-solving, and communication skills for cross-functional collaboration.
  • Experience with microservices, GoLang, or Node.js for complementary service integration (nice to have).


You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:

  • Design, develop, and maintain Ruby on Rails applications with a focus on scalability and performance.
  • Build and manage AWS infrastructure components using Terraform and DevOps best practices.
  • Implement and maintain serverless solutions leveraging AWS Lambda and related services.
  • Integrate and maintain APIs and external systems, ensuring reliability and data consistency.
  • Refactor legacy components to improve maintainability, performance, and code clarity.
  • Write and maintain automated tests (RSpec, Minitest) to ensure high code quality and coverage.
  • Monitor application performance and proactively address issues or bottlenecks.
  • Collaborate on CI/CD pipelines, ensuring secure, consistent, and efficient deployments.
  • Participate in code reviews, maintaining high-quality development standards.
  • Engage in Agile ceremonies (standups, sprint planning, reviews, retrospectives).
  • Work closely with front-end, DevOps, and QA teams to deliver robust, end-to-end solutions.


Additional Information

Here at Applaudo Studios values as trust, communication, respect, excellence and team work are our keys to success. We know we are working with the best and thus treat each other with respect and admiration without asking.

Submit your application today, and don't miss this opportunity to join the Best Digital team in the Region!

We truly appreciate all the hard and outstanding work our team makes every day at Applaudo Studios, and that's why the perks that we offer, are deeply thought and designed as a way to thank them for their commitment and excellence.


Some of our perks and benefits:

  • Celebrations
  • Special discounts*
  • Entertainment area*
  • Modern Work Spaces*
  • Great work environment
  • Private medical insurance*


*Benefits may vary according to your location and/or availability. Request further information when applying.

title: Desenvolvedor Apex PL/SQL
description:
Responsabilidades:


- Colaborar com a equipe de desenvolvimento para compreender requisitos e transformá-los em soluções técnicas robustas;

- Desenvolver e manter aplicações web utilizando Oracle APEX e PL/SQL, garantindo performance, segurança e alta disponibilidade;

- Projetar e implementar modelos de banco de dados, consultas SQL otimizadas e procedimentos armazenados;

- Realizar testes unitários e de integração para assegurar a qualidade e estabilidade do código;

- Identificar e resolver gargalos de desempenho, otimizando consultas SQL quando necessário;

- Trabalhar em conjunto com equipes multidisciplinares, garantindo a entrega eficiente e dentro dos prazos.


Requisitos:


- Experiência comprovada no desenvolvimento de aplicações web com Oracle APEX;

- Forte conhecimento em PL/SQL e SQL, incluindo otimização de consultas e modelagem de dados;

- Familiaridade com boas práticas de desenvolvimento, controle de versão e metodologias ágeis;

- Capacidade de atuar de forma independente e colaborativa, gerenciando múltiplas demandas simultaneamente;

- Excelentes habilidades de comunicação verbal e escrita;

- Formação superior em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software ou áreas correlatas (ou experiência equivalente).

description:
Join the Virtual Latinos Community!


With over 5,000+ VA's hired that are part of our community and 2,500+ companies helped , Virtual Latinos stands out as the first American company connecting exceptional virtual professionals from Latin America with small businesses and entrepreneurs across the US, Canada, and beyond.


Within our community, 10+ new job positions become available every week, providing professionals like you with fantastic remote job opportunities. Ready to explore the possibilities?


Apply today and become part of a community where your skills shine and your career aspirations soar!


Highlight Job of the week!


Job Title: Legal Assistant


Pay Rate LinkedIn style:


Part-Time Monthly Rates : $880-$1,440 (based on 20 hours per week schedule)

Full-Time Monthly Rates : $1,760-$2,880 (based on 40 hours per week schedule)


The monthly salary range posted is stipulated as an average monthly income. However, all jobs at Virtual Latinos are hourly-based, and payments are calculated on the number of hours a person works daily. We pay our Virtual Professionals every 2 weeks through third-party platforms. The hourly rate range of the position is $11 - $18 depending on experience. Once a rate has been offered to you, it is non-negotiable.



Work Schedule:


The work schedule will vary depending on the job position that you will apply for as it will be based on the schedule requested by the client. All our clients are in the U.S. and work schedules will be in the U.S. time zone.



Job Summary : The Legal Assistant will be responsible for providing comprehensive support to attorneys, performing legal research, drafting documents, and maintaining client files.


Job Tasks :


  • Legal Research and Documentation: Conduct legal research and prepare various legal documents.
  • Case Management : Manage and organize case files and documents.
  • Client Interaction: Communicate with clients for information gathering and updates.
  • Administrative Support: Handle clerical tasks, manage calendars, and answer phone calls.
  • Court Preparation: Help attorneys prepare for court by organizing documents and coordinating logistics.
  • Compliance and Reporting: Ensure legal compliance and assist in filing documents with courts.


Qualifications:


  • 1 year of related experience and/or a related degree.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English
  • Ability to excel in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong organizational abilities.
  • Meticulous attention to detail.
  • Collaborative team spirit.
  • Commitment to confidentiality.
  • A quiet, private workspace.
  • Must be at least 21 years old.


Languages:


  • English mandatory
  • Portuguese mandatory


Next Steps:


  • Send your easy apply
  • We will reach out and send you a form to send in your full application
  • Get accepted into our community to have access to all our job offers
  • Apply to job offers of your interest
  • Get interviewed
  • Start working in your dream Job!

At Palo Alto Networks® everything starts and ends with our mission:

Being the cybersecurity partner of choice, protecting our digital way of life.
Our vision is a world where each day is safer and more secure than the one before. We are a company built on the foundation of challenging and disrupting the way things are done, and we’re looking for innovators who are as committed to shaping the future of cybersecurity as we are.

Who We Are

This role is remote, but distance is no barrier to impact. Our hybrid teams collaborate across geographies to solve big problems, stay close to our customers, and grow together. You will be part of a culture that values trust, accountability, and shared success where your work truly matters.

Your Career

You will join an exciting and high growth business unit with Palo Alto Networks positioning the industry’s most comprehensive SASE security platform, with the industry’s broadest security and compliance coverage for applications used by your hybrid workforce, regardless of whether they are at home, on the go, or in the office.

In this role, you will be responsible for managing a territory focusing on Major, Strategic, and Enterprise Accounts. Working closely with Palo Alto business partners and driving sales for our Enterprise Browser security solution, into new and existing customers. It is expected that you deliver or exceed your sales targets in both new business and renewals for ACV and TCV bookings. The role expects you to define your territory, strategies and then lead local execution and in alignment to company strategies and tactics within the Prisma SASE organization.

  • Track and report on all opportunities, pipeline, and bookings to provide forecast reports to region management
  • Establish relationships and engage with the local reseller and alliance partners on sales programs and joint activities

title: Cientista de Dados
description:
Modelo de trabalho: Remoto

Contratação: CLT


Profissional com sólida experiência em Ciência de Dados e Machine Learning , atuando com IA Generativa , modelos de ponta (estado da arte) e ambiente Databricks . Deve possuir forte capacidade analítica, curiosidade técnica e visão prática de aplicação de modelos para geração de valor ao negócio.


Responsabilidades e atribuições


O profissional atuará em um projeto estratégico de IA Generativa aplicada à BU de Moda , com foco inicial na geração de imagens e vídeos de produtos , troca de fundos e criação de conteúdo multimídia para redes sociais. A iniciativa tem potencial de expansão para os segmentos de vestuário e beleza , visando a construção de soluções escaláveis e inovadoras.


  • Desenvolver e evoluir modelos de Inteligência Artificial voltados à geração e manipulação de imagens (foto realismo, avatares e vídeos).
  • Criar soluções para vitrines virtuais e conteúdos multimídia (ex.: troca de fundos, inserção de produtos em cenários relevantes).
  • Apoiar a construção de ferramentas internas de IA, como inserção de prompts, seleção de roupas e recomendações personalizadas de looks.

Principais Competências Técnicas

1. Linguagens e Frameworks

  • C# (nível avançado)
  • .NET 6 / 7 / 8 e .NET Core
  • ASP.NET MVC / Web API
  • Entity Framework Core (ORM)


2. Arquitetura e Design

  • Arquiteturas em camadas, limpa (Clean Architecture) e hexagonal
  • Padrões de projeto (Factory, Singleton, Strategy, CQRS, Mediator etc.)
  • DDD (Domain-Driven Design)
  • Microservices e arquitetura orientada a eventos
  • Integração via APIs RESTful e GraphQL


3. Banco de Dados e Persistência

  • SQL Server, PostgreSQL, Oracle


4. Cloud e DevOps

  • Azure: App Services, Functions, Service Bus, AKS, DevOps Pipelines
  • AWS: Elastic Beanstalk, Lambda, RDS, SQS, ECS
  • Contêineres: Docker, Kubernetes
  • CI/CD e versionamento (Git, GitFlow, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps)
  • Infraestrutura como Código (Terraform, Bicep, ARM Templates)

title: Regulatory Affairs Manager
description:
Manager Regulatory Affairs – Global Labeling Product Leader

Location: Brazil (Remote)

Type: Full Time | 12 Month Fixed Term Contract (FTC)

Start Date: ASAP


About the Company:


Our client is a global healthcare leader specializing in innovative pharmaceutical and medical products that improve patient outcomes worldwide. With a strong focus on quality, safety, and compliance, the company operates across multiple therapeutic areas and global markets. The successful candidate will join a collaborative Regulatory Affairs organization driving excellence in labeling compliance and product lifecycle management.


Position Summary:


The Manager Global Labeling Product Leader is responsible for the development maintenance and quality oversight of primary and derived product labeling documents across global markets. This position ensures that labeling content is compliant with international regulations and internal quality standards while contributing to global labeling strategy and product lifecycle management.

You will act as a key liaison between cross functional teams including Regulatory Affairs Safety Medical and Commercial to deliver consistent compliant and scientifically accurate product information.


Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the creation revision and maintenance of primary and derived labeling documents (for example CCDS USPI SmPC) ensuring alignment with regulatory requirements and company strategy.
  • Collaborate cross functionally with Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) through Labeling Working Groups (LWG) and Labeling Committees (LC) to gain consensus on labeling content.
  • Develop labeling text supported by clinical preclinical and safety data considering competitor and market context.
  • Ensure the accuracy clarity and scientific integrity of labeling documents through effective data review and documentation traceability.
  • Support the implementation of global labeling strategies including the development of target labeling for new and existing products.
  • Partner with Global Regulatory Affairs (GRA) and Global Labeling Operations (GLO) to ensure dissemination and alignment of labeling deliverables.
  • Maintain up to date understanding of global labeling regulations (EU US and international) CIOMS guidance and industry best practices.
  • Support audits inspections and Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) management related to labeling activities.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives to optimize labeling processes and documentation quality.
  • Provide labeling support and guidance to regional and local operating companies ensuring compliance across markets.


Qualifications and Experience


Essential:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Life Sciences Pharmacy or a related discipline .
  • Minimum 4 years of experience in the pharmaceutical or healthcare industry with at least 3 years in Regulatory Affairs and product labeling.
  • Proven understanding of global labeling regulations (FDA EMA CIOMS) and regulatory documentation standards.
  • Demonstrated ability to interpret clinical and technical data and translate findings into compliant labeling text.
  • Strong skills in scientific writing data interpretation and document management systems (DMS) .
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to work in a matrixed cross functional environment .
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Word with working knowledge of Excel and PowerPoint .


Desirable:

  • Advanced degree (MS PhD MD or PharmD) in a life sciences discipline.
  • Experience leading projects or small teams in a global regulatory or labeling capacity.
  • Previous participation in process improvement or compliance initiatives .
  • Experience with labeling systems and tools supporting compliance and document traceability.


Key Competencies

  • Strong scientific and analytical thinking.
  • Excellent attention to detail and quality orientation.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities effectively.
  • Clear and professional communication with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Proactive problem solving and decision making mindset.
  • Collaborative customer focused and continuous improvement driven approach.

title: Analytics Engineering Senior
description:
Transformar o varejo da construção civil com tecnologia, inteligência e propósito — esse é o nosso negócio.

A Juntos Somos Mais nasceu em 2018 como uma startup de tecnologia com um sonho grande: impulsionar o setor de material de construção em todo o Brasil, conectando indústria, varejo e profissionais da obra por meio de um ecossistema de soluções inovadoras.


Com o apoio dos nossos acionistas — Votorantim Cimentos, Gerdau e Tigre —, movimentamos mais de R$10 bilhões em nossa Loja Virtual em 2024, impactando mais de 100 mil lojas e 1,2 milhão de membros entre lojistas, vendedores e profissionais de obra.


Somos movidos por um time diverso, inquieto e protagonista — gente que sonha grande, age com autonomia e coloca o cliente no centro de tudo. Aqui, valorizamos quem se dedica a entender as dores reais do varejo e busca, com consistência, soluções que gerem valor e resultados para os nossos usuários.


Se você tem perfil empreendedor, é apaixonado por construir soluções com foco no cliente e quer deixar sua marca em um dos setores mais importantes do país, chega mais.


Você fará parte do time de Ciência de Dados da Juntos Somos Mais.

O time de Ciência de Dados da Juntos Somos Mais atua de forma transversal na companhia em projetos de alto potencial de impacto financeiro explorando métodos estatísticos e de aprendizagem de máquina. Estamos em busca de um profissional especialista em Ciência de Dados com experiência comprovada para impulsionar nosso crescimento e inovação através da utilização eficiente e impactante dos dados.


Seu papel:

Seu dia a dia será assim:

  • Modelar dados para atender necessidades específicas das áreas de negócio.
  • Construir produtos de dados centrados no usuário (pipelines, indicadores, dashboards).
  • Desenvolver modelos, tabelas e relatórios que representem a "fonte da verdade" (Gold/Diamond - arquitetura medalhão) .
  • Garantir a qualidade e consistência dos dados em múltiplas plataformas, assegurando a precisão dos dados utilizados nas análises.
  • Suportar a implantação e utilizar o catálogo Unity no Databricks para documentar e organizar ativos de dados, garantindo as políticas de governança.
  • Promover o uso estratégico dos dados na resolução de problemas de negócio.


O que esperamos de você:

  • SQL Avançado: Proficiência em SQL, com habilidade para escrever e otimizar consultas complexas.
  • Modelagem e Pipelines: Experiência com ferramentas de ETL/ELT (e.g., Azure Data Factory ou similares).
  • Visão Analítica: Habilidades analíticas e estatísticas, com capacidade de aplicar técnicas para resolver problemas de negócios.
  • Ferramentas: Conhecimento em Python para análise de dados (PySpark é um diferencial) e ferramentas de análise (Metabase, Power BI).
  • Soft Skills: Orientação para resultados , foco em alcançar metas e melhorar os processos de negócios.


O que pode te destacar:

  • Domínio do Databricks para engenharia, análise e ciência de dados.
  • Experiência comprovada com Governança de Dados e aplicação prática do Unity como Catálogo de Dados no Databricks.
  • Experiência prática com modelos de LLM ou aplicação de processamento de linguagem natural.


Nosso processo seletivo e compromisso com a diversidade

Na #Juntos, valorizamos a jornada de aprendizagem mútua: queremos descobrir, juntos, o potencial de cada pessoa em todas as etapas do processo. Nosso objetivo é criar uma experiência transparente, justa e eficiente, alinhada aos nossos valores e à nossa cultura de protagonismo e impacto.

Acreditamos que um time diverso e autêntico é essencial para gerar soluções verdadeiramente inovadoras. Aqui, você será encorajado a ser você mesmo(a), trazendo suas singularidades para somar ao coletivo. Promovemos inclusão de forma concreta, com ações afirmativas que buscam ampliar vozes de diferentes origens e perspectivas.


Se você busca um ambiente onde pode ser quem é, aprender com liberdade e contribuir com impacto real, seu lugar pode ser aqui. Vem construir com a gente o maior ecossistema da construção civil!

description:

title: Supervisor de Enfermagem - Laboratório Diagnoson a +
description:
Quais são os desafios da área e do cargo:


Esta pessoa terá como objetivo atuar de forma alinhada à visão estratégica de Negócios do Grupo Fleury, contribuindo para a construção de um ecossistema de Saúde integrado, preventivo e híbrido, tendo como principal foco o cuidado com as pessoas.

Se você tem interesse em fazer parte desse propósito e deseja estar sempre um passo a frente do mercado, vem com a gente!


Principais Atividades:


Garantir a melhoria dos processos de assistência de enfermagem com foco na satisfação do cliente a qualidade dos procedimentos por meio da atuação como referência técnica na sua área de especialidade, interna e externamente à empresa, realizando a análise crítica dos processos, identificando oportunidades e propondo mudanças em conformidade com as políticas e normas da empresa e melhores práticas de mercado;

Atuar como líder técnico dos técnicos III, II e I, assistentes de enfermagem e auxiliar de enfermagem I e II provendo feedback e aconselhamentos na rotina diária da área de processos de atendimento;

Contribuir para o desenvolvimento das equipes de enfermagem por meio do apoio na elaboração de treinamentos e conteúdo de divulgação da área;

Contribuir para a eficiência dos processos, reduzindo recoletas, reclamações de clientes e contaminação de amostras e exames.

Assegurar a organização e divisão de atividades para equipe assistencial subordinada, por meio de escala mensal, semanal e diária;

Assegurar o suporte às necessidades dos clientes nas situações mais complexas, garantindo o atendimento à casos emergenciais, prestando primeiros socorros e encaminhando para atendimento especializado;

Garantir o atendimento adequado às demandas de enfermagem das unidades por meio da coleta de materiais e execução de exames em casos especiais (coletas e exames infantis, coletas assistidas, entre outros).

Assegurar o desenvolvimento dos processos de promoção à saúde por meio da condução de treinamentos, apoio na elaboração dos materiais e divulgação junto a colaboradores e clientes;

Garantir a excelência do atendimento aos clientes por meio do cumprimento de padrões e normas de qualidade, fornecendo orientações e esclarecimento dúvidas relativas às atividades realizadas.

Executar coletas e exames de maior complexidade e específicos de enfermeiros (tais como cateter, panicolau, gasometria, entre outros), seguindo procedimentos estabelecidos e atendendo as demandas da unidade;

Atuar como responsável técnico pela unidade em que atua por meio do esclarecendo dúvidas e orientação à equipe de enfermagem e demais colaboradores, bem como pelo atendimento emergencial à clientes.


Buscamos alguém que apresente:

Superior completo em Enfermagem com Coren ativo e em dia;

Necessário vivência como Enfermeiro Assistencial;

Necessário experiência com gestão de pessoas;

Será um diferencial: Conhecimento em rotinas laboratorial e exames de imagem;

Pós-Graduação completa ou cursando preferencialmente nas áreas: Cardiologia, Pronto Atendimento (adulto e/ou infantil), Obstetrícia, Ginecologia, Educação Continuada, Oncologia/Imunoterapia, ou Medicina Diagnóstica.



O que esperamos?

• Nossa essência inspira nosso dia a dia, por isso, buscamos alguém alinhado ao propósito de cuidar das pessoas

• Alguém que zele por cuidado e empatia durante toda a jornada, trazendo o cliente sempre para o centro das ações, buscando a excelência;

• Desejo de aprender, valorização do trabalho em equipe e troca de conhecimento.


Sobre a vaga:

Jornada de trabalho de 220h - Das 07:00 as 16:00 de seg a sex e aos sábados das 07:00 as 11:00 - Domingos e feriados por escala com folgas na semana seguinte.

Contrato de Trabalho: Regime CLT

Importante: Flexibilidade de descolamento para Unidades do Laboratório a+ / Atendimento Móvel e Diagnoson

Local: 100% remoto

Regime: PJ ou Coop

Sobre a posição

Estamos em busca de um Desenvolvedor Sênior ABAP / Fiori para atuar em projetos estratégicos de modernização e evolução tecnológica no ecossistema SAP S/4HANA e SAP BTP (Business Technology Platform) .

O profissional será responsável por desenvolver soluções modernas utilizando ABAP Cloud e RAP (Restful ABAP Programming Model) integradas a SAP Fiori / UI5 , aplicando boas práticas de clean core e arquitetura extensível.

  • Experiência em S/4HANA Cloud (Public ou Private Edition) .

title: Video Ad Copywriter – Paid Media & AI-Driven Creative
description:
About the Role

Property Leads is a fast-growing real estate lead generation and data company. We’re looking for a Paid Media Ad Copywriter who can craft high-performing copy across multiple digital channels. This role blends creative storytelling with performance marketing expertise , you’ll write, test, and optimize ad copy that drives engagement and lead generation.

You’ll collaborate closely with the team to develop data-driven ad messaging that scales across platforms. If you love combining words, metrics, and AI tools to create ads that convert — this role is for you.

Responsibilities Copywriting for Performance
  • Write and test compelling copy for paid ads across Meta, TikTok, Google, and YouTube .

  • Craft headlines, primary text, CTAs, scripts , and short-form hooks that align with each platform’s audience behavior.

  • Adapt messaging for various funnel stages (TOFU, MOFU, BOFU) to optimize conversions.

  • Collaborate with designers and video editors to align visuals and copy for cohesive creative execution.

    • Creative Strategy & Optimization
    • Develop multiple copy variations for A/B testing and analyze performance metrics like CTR, CPA, ROAS, and conversion rate .

    • Use data insights and feedback from the Paid Media team to refine messaging and improve outcomes.

    • Research competitors, market trends, and ad libraries to identify new creative angles.

    • Maintain an organized library of top-performing headlines, hooks, and frameworks.

    • AI & Automation
    • Leverage AI tools such as ChatGPT, Jasper, Copy.ai, ElevenLabs, HeyGen, or Runway to assist in scriptwriting, ideation, and ad copy generation.

    • Experiment with AI-driven testing to quickly iterate and scale winning copy.

    • Collaboration & Workflow
    • Work with the Creative, Media Buying, and Strategy teams to ensure copy aligns with campaign goals.

    • Meet deadlines for consistent delivery of new ad variations.

    • Take initiative in creative brainstorming sessions and performance reviews.

    • Expected Outcomes
    • Increased ad engagement and click-through rates (CTR).

    • Improved conversion rates and reduced cost per acquisition (CPA).

    • Faster creative testing cycles through AI and automation.

    • Consistent production of fresh, high-performing copy variants.

    • Qualifications Required
    • 3–5 years of experience writing copy for paid media (Meta, TikTok, YouTube, or Google).

    • Strong understanding of performance metrics (CTR, CPA, ROAS, etc.) and how copy impacts them.

    • Proven track record in direct response, lead generation, or performance marketing .

    • Excellent command of English , with attention to detail and tone adaptation.

    • Experience using AI tools to ideate or generate ad concepts and scripts.

    • Ability to work independently and manage multiple deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

    • Preferred
    • Experience in real estate, e-commerce, or lead generation industries.

    • Familiarity with UGC-style scripting and short-form video ad copy.

    • Basic understanding of media buying and campaign structure.

    • Knowledge of AI-driven creative workflows (text-to-video, voiceovers, etc.).

    • Benefits
    • Competitive compensation

    • 100% remote work-from-anywhere environment

    • Collaborative, innovative culture that values data, creativity, and growth

title: Senior AI Engineer (Python / Node.js)
description:
We are seeking a remote, full-time Senior AI Engineer with 5+ years of software and AI/ML engineering experience. Candidates must have a strong background in Python and either Golang, Node.js, or Java expertise, with a strong desire to adopt Golang as the primary back-end technology.

In this position, you will be at the heart of the client's product innovation, responsible for designing, implementing, and operationalizing AI-native services that transform the utility sector. This role combines applied AI/ML expertise with strong back-end engineering skills, ensuring the client's agentic systems are not only functional but scalable, secure, and production-ready.

As a key member of our engineering team, you will report directly to the CTO and operate within small, agile teams alongside software engineers, security experts, and product managers. You will own the full lifecycle of AI services from data ingestion and model training to real-time deployment and monitoring while continuously adapting to evolving requirements in a fast-moving, high-stakes industry.

Our client is building an AI-centric operating system for utilities. It harnesses AI at the enterprise level to better orchestrate customer delight, facilitate power optimization, improve the health of the grid, and unlock flexibility at scale. Funded by a strategic industry partner and one of the founders at Groupon, the client is poised to transform how utilities run and how customers experience energy.


Responsibilities

  • AI Systems Development : Architect, fine-tune, and deploy AI agents purpose-built for utility use cases, including predictive operations, customer engagement, and energy optimization
  • Back-End Integration : Build APIs, microservices, and orchestration frameworks that seamlessly connect AI models with enterprise systems and grid-level data flows
  • Pipeline Ownership : Design and manage the complete AI pipeline ingestion, embeddings, retrieval, evaluation, and continuous deployment, ensuring reliability and scalability
  • AI Risk Mitigation : Address vulnerabilities unique to AI, such as model drift, bias exploitation, adversarial robustness, and hallucination control with sensitivity to regulated environments
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration : Partner with software engineers, data specialists, and security teams to integrate AI capabilities into the broader client OS, embedding AI by design into every product release
  • Speed of Delivery : Operate with urgency, delivering breakthroughs in code and AI services on cycles measured in weeks, not quarters.


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 5+ years of applied ML/AI engineering experience, ideally with exposure to enterprise/mission-critical systems.
  • Strong proficiency in Python and either Golang, Node.js, or Java (non-Golang developers will learn and adopt Golang on the job)
  • Expertise with ML/LLM frameworks, such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, LangChain, or equivalent
  • Experience with vector databases, orchestration frameworks, and modern MLOps practices.
  • Track record of deploying AI services in production
  • Strong grounding in cloud-native architectures (AWS, GCP, Azure)
  • Analytical, collaborative, and comfortable with ambiguity.
  • Ability to thrive in small, high-velocity teams, balancing experimentation with production rigor


Desired Experience

  • University degree or relevant industry experience
  • Experience working on ERP systems or within the power utilities industry


Additional Information

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company
  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture, share knowledge, be inclusive, learn, and grow together. Embrace teamwork!
  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP

  • Capacidade de construir parcerias estratégicas e identificar oportunidades de crescimento.

title: Bolsista Doutor - Digital Care 2 You- Aplicação de Inteligência Artificial na Jornada do paciente | Doutores Inovando no Setor Empresarial - IEL/PR
description:
A Fundação Araucária, em parceria com o IEL Paraná, oferece às empresas paranaenses um programa inovador que conecta seu negócio a doutores profissionais. O Doutores Inovando no Setor Empresarial oportunizará expertise técnica, científica e metodológica, essenciais para impulsionar o crescimento, a inovação e aumentar a sustentabilidade da sua empresa, fortalecendo seu posicionamento no cenário competitivo.

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
We’re Flowmentum and our clients are fast-moving teams building reliable, scalable, and secure infrastructure for companies shaping the future of AI, fintech, cloud services, and beyond.

Our engineers work on high-traffic, mission-critical systems that power millions of users across the globe.

We believe in autonomy, ownership, and solving hard problems — at scale. If you’re passionate about infrastructure done right, we want you on the team.



What You’ll Do:

  • Design and deploy cloud-native systems on AWS , that just work — at scale.
  • Own Kubernetes clusters : architecture, automation, observability, and performance tuning.
  • Build Terraform modules and GitOps pipelines to make deployments boring (in a good way).
  • Create CI/CD pipelines that are fast, reliable, and get new features into production safely.
  • Automate everything — provisioning, monitoring, security — with the best tools for the job.
  • Push systems to 99.99% uptime across billions of transactions a year.
  • Partner directly with product engineers, security, and leadership to ship infrastructure that accelerates growth.
  • Mentor teammates, review pull requests, and help define best practices as we scale.

You Should Have:

  • 7+ years of experience in DevOps , Cloud Engineering , or Site Reliability Engineering .
  • Strong Proven track record with LAMP (Linux Apache Mysql PHP)
  • Strong real-world experience with AWS , Kubernetes , and Terraform .
  • A deep understanding of Linux, containers, networking, and cloud-native security.
  • Proven ability to scale systems to handle high-volume , high-availability workloads.
  • Hands-on skills in scripting or coding — Python , Go , or Bash are all great.
  • An eye for automation and eliminating manual work wherever you find it.
  • Startup or growth-stage experience (bonus points).
  • Excellent async communication skills (Slack, GitHub, Docs).


Bonus Points If You’ve:

  • Built infrastructure for AI/ML systems, SaaS, or telco-scale apps.
  • Used tools like GitHub Actions , ArgoCD , Vault , Elastic Stack , or EKS .
  • Led technical teams or been a mentor for junior engineers.
  • Got certifications like AWS Solutions Architect, CKA, or Azure Admin.

title: Analista Recrutamento e Seleção Junior
description:
A Genesis Consulting é uma empresa global de consultoria que apoia clientes líderes em suas jornadas de Transformação Digital, soluções de tecnologia de ponta.

Atuamos em projetos estratégicos e desafiadores em diversos países, conectando talentos de alto nível a oportunidades que impulsionam inovação.

Estamos em busca de uma Analista de Recrutamento e Seleção – Tecnologia para integrar o time com foco em velocidade, assertividade e qualidade na entrega de candidatos tech.


Responsabilidades

• Conduzir processos de recrutamento e seleção, com foco em posições de tecnologia

• Realizar triagem rápida e precisa de currículos, priorizando aderência técnica

• Manter um pipeline ativo e constantemente atualizado, garantindo agilidade nas entregas;

• Buscar e engajar candidatos por meio de hunting ativo no LinkedIn, job boards, bancos de talentos e comunidades de tecnologia;

• Manter comunicação constante e engajadora com os candidatos, garantindo boa experiência e relacionamento contínuo;

• Gerenciar ferramentas de recrutamento (como Notion e LinkedIn Recruiter)

• Desenvolver redes de relacionamento e comunidades para fortalecer o pipeline de talentos;


Requisitos e Qualificações

• Experiência prévia de 3+ anos em Recrutamento Tech

• Conhecimento prático em triagem técnica (linguagens, frameworks e perfis de tecnologia);

• Domínio de plataformas de recrutamento e ferramentas de hunting

• Experiência com vagas e senso de urgência para entregas rápidas;

• Capacidade de gerenciar múltiplos processos simultaneamente com alta organização;

• Boa comunicação escrita e interpessoal, com foco em relacionamento e engajamento de candidatos;

• São vem vindos perfils com proativa, ágil e organizada, com paixão por conectar talentos de tecnologia a grandes oportunidades.

• Formação em Psicologia, Administração, Recursos Humanos ou áreas correlatas;



Por que a Genesis?

• Ambiente global, projetos de ponta em digital transformation, business agility e SAP.

• Cultura centrada em entrega de valor, colaboração, integridade e performance.

• Sua entrega aqui impulsiona não só resultados para nossos clientes, mas também sua própria trajetória de crescimento e impacto.

Que tal se juntar a nós e se tornar um(a) #FourTalent? Então se liga nessa oportunidade incrível:


Responsabilidades e atribuições


Customização e evolução da ferramenta de glossário de termos, alinhando a conceitos de domínios e capacidades do framework BIAN,

Desenvolver e aplicar regras na ferramenta de pré validação de modelos de dados utilizando Regex em C#,

Apoiar o time de Governança de Dados na adoção dos padrões BIAN,

Administrar e modelar dados (conceitual, lógica e física),

Apoiar iniciativas de governança de dados,

Trabalhar em conjunto com arquitetos, analistas e equipes de desenvolvimento.

Experiência sólida em administração e modelagem de dados,

Conhecimento prático em automação processos e ferramentas de IA

Conhecimento na esteira CI/CD,

Familiaridade com ferramentas de modelagem como Erwin ou similares,

Experiência com bancos de dados relacionais e NoSQL,

Formação superior em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas,

Inglês intermediário ou avançado.


Formato de trabalho: Home office


E temos também o Clube da Four que oferece ótimas vantagens!

title: Customer Service Agent / Survey
description:
Company Description


Best Servicers of America is an innovative provider of on-site services solutions, dedicated to enhancing brand image and customer service experience. We offer accurate diagnostic and technical support and follow-up phone calls to ensure customer satisfaction. Our team works closely with businesses to tailor our services to meet their unique requirements, dispatching professional technicians to provide total business solutions.


Role Description


We are looking for a detail-oriented and proactive Billing Specialist to join our Billing Department. This role plays a key part in ensuring accuracy in service repair claims and payments. You will review completed repairs, confirm pricing, submit claims to customers, and verify technician payments. Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and problem-solving abilities are essential, as this position directly impacts financial accuracy and customer satisfaction.


Key Responsibilities


  • Review completed repair tickets to ensure all prices and charges are correct.
  • Submit claims to customers and follow up to resolve any issues.
  • Verify and process payments for technicians who completed the repairs.
  • Make phone calls in English to technicians, customers, and consumers when clarification or updates are needed.
  • Contact customers to correct claim issues and provide status updates.
  • Collaborate with the billing and operations team to support overall department efficiency.
  • Proactively identify and solve problems to avoid delays in payments or claims processing.


Qualifications


  • Previous experience in billing, claims, customer service, or a similar role (preferred but not required).
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.
  • Ability to learn quickly and work efficiently in a fast-paced environment.
  • Excellent communication skills in English (verbal and written).
  • Proactive, problem-solving mindset with the ability to work both independently and as part of a team.
  • Computer proficiency (MS Office, email, Excel).


Please read before applying:


You will be receiving an email with a DocuSign form to be completed.

Contact me on Skype. At the end of the form, there is a Skype link to contact me to schedule the interview time and date.

Only the candidates who read and complete all the steps will be interviewed.


***RESUMES MUST BE SENT IN ENGLISH ONLY***


We are looking for people who want to grow with us.


The position we have at this moment is in the Logistics Department. 


The job is from Monday to Friday, 8:00 to 17:00 or 9:00 to 18:00 (USA Eastern Standard Time). This opportunity is for someone who can work unsupervised and work from home.


The requirements are:


- Having a fast computer (minimum 8 GB of RAM) and a headset with a microphone that you can use to work (no earbuds or AirPods).

- Having high-speed internet (100mbps or faster) access at home.

- Have a quiet environment (no dogs barking, babies crying, loud music, street noises, or similar in the background).

- Two screens to start the training (will ask for pictures before the interview).

title: Inside Sales Account Executive, North America
description:
Location: anywhere in LATAM


JoVE is the world-leading producer and provider of video solutions with the mission to improve scientific research and education. Millions of scientists, educators and students use JoVE for their research, teaching and learning. Our institutional clients comprise over 1,000 universities, colleges, and biopharma companies, including such leaders as Harvard, MIT, Yale, and Stanford. As a rapidly growing company, with offices in the USA, UK, Australia, and India servicing clients in over 60 countries, we are seeking talented and ambitious individuals to join our company.


The Role


We are looking for dedicated sales professionals to drive adoption of our product at universities and colleges in North America. An ideal candidate is a result-oriented achiever, who is effective in a remote work environment and strives to succeed and grow with the company.


Responsibilities :


  • Own full sales cycle, from prospecting to close. Meet or exceed sales goals.
  • Craft and execute your territory sales plan & progress opportunities in the pipeline.
  • Provide product demos to researchers, teaching faculty and academic librarians in North America.
  • Proactively communicate with clients and users through emails and calls.
  • Analyze trends and make data driven decisions on priorities in your work.
  • Work effectively with other teams such as marketing to deliver on sales targets, team projects and campaigns.


Requirements :


  • A Bachelor’s degree.
  • 3 to 5 years of experience in sales, preferably in EdTech, STEM Publishing or SaaS.
  • Excellent English communication, presentation and negotiation skills.
  • Experienced with Salesforce and platforms such as Hubspot.
  • Confidence in dealing with clients and product users.
  • Self-motivated, initiative, results-oriented and willing to learn new skills.
  • A drive to succeed and a proven ability to be resilient and overcome challenges.


Why Join JoVE?


  • A competitive compensation package including unlimited commissions on your sales
  • You will make a direct impact in accelerating science research and education.
  • Opportunity to work with global teams and in an environment that promotes innovation and collaboration.
  • Our strong promotion from within culture draws a clear path to advance your career with us.

title: Mathematics/Statics Subject Matter Expert (Master/PHD)
description:
Innodata (NASDAQ: INOD) is a leading data engineering company. With more than 2,000 customers and operations in 13 cities around the world, we are an AI technology solutions provider of choice for 4 out of 5 of the world’s biggest technology companies, as well as leading companies across financial services, insurance, technology, law, and medicine.

By combining advanced machine learning and artificial intelligence (ML/AI) technologies, a global workforce of subject matter experts, and a high-security infrastructure, we’re helping usher in the promise of AI. Innodata offers a powerful combination of both digital data solutions and easy-to-use, high-quality platforms.

Our global workforce includes over 5,000 employees in the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, the Philippines, India, Sri Lanka, Israel and Germany. We’re poised for a period of explosive growth over the next few years.


About the Role:


At Innodata, we’re working with the world’s largest technology companies on the next generation of generative AI and large language models (LLMs). We’re looking for smart, savvy, and curious subject matter experts.


We are seeking a Mathematics Subject Matter Expert with exceptional writing and analytical skills to join our AI/ML data team. In this role, you will help train advanced Large Language Models (LLMs) by producing, curating, and reviewing high-quality educational and technical mathematics content. Your expertise will directly shape the way AI systems understand, explain, and reason about fundamental and advanced mathematical concepts.


Key Responsibilities:


Create high-quality, accurate, and pedagogically sound content in mathematics, including:

  • Conceptual explanations
  • Problem sets and solutions
  • Theoretical summaries and derivations
  • Research abstracts and technical writing


Collaborate with AI researchers and engineers to:


  • Review and refine mathematics-related model outputs
  • Identify and fill conceptual gaps in LLM training data
  • Build datasets across various mathematics domains (e.g., Algebra, Calculus, Geometry, Linear Algebra, Probability, Statistics, Number Theory, Discrete Math, etc.)
  • Provide feedback to improve LLM performance in reasoning, solving, and communicating mathematical content


Eligibility Criteria:

  • Master's or PhD in Mathematics or a closely related discipline (MS with exceptional experience may be considered)
  • Strong background in theoretical and/or applied mathematics
  • Excellent technical and academic writing skills


As part of the project, you are required to complete the English language assessment.

*The assessment is mandatory & non-billable*

title: Engenheiro de dados
description:
Quem somos:


Prezensa, uma empresa de Tecnologia com foco em pessoas e compromisso real com resultados.


Nascemos da fusão de três consultorias com mais de 10 anos de trajetória (ESX, DevLand e Squad Premium) para criar um novo modelo no setor: mais humano, mais presente, mais estratégico.

Fomos pioneiros ao lançar a primeira PeopleTech do Brasil, unindo excelência técnica com acompanhamento próximo, de ponta a ponta.

Aqui, cada profissional é acompanhado, cada cliente é ouvido e cada entrega tem propósito.

Nossa cultura é baseada em transparência, colaboração e inovação. Valorizamos a autonomia e o desenvolvimento contínuo de nossos talentos.


Você se identifica com esse propósito? Então, o seu futuro é na Prezensa.

Requisitos da vaga


Hard skills:


  • Stack Adobe;
  • GCP (BigQuery, Dataflow e Pub/Sub);
  • DBT (modelagem, macros, documentação e testes);
  • Background em Engenharia de Dados para IA (feature store, vetorização e qualidade de datasets);
  • MCP para alinhamento de eventos com workflows;
  • SQL e Python para Dataflow;
  • Dashboards (Looker / Power BI / Tableau).


Soft skills:


  • Trabalho em equipe;
  • Proatividade;
  • Dinamismo;
  • Bom relacionamento interpessoal e com cliente;
  • Senso de urgência;
  • Objetividade e clareza na exposição de ideias para o time;
  • Boa comunicação oral e escrita.


Diferenciais


  • Vertex AI Feature Store;
  • SageMaker Feature Store;
  • Streaming analytics em tempo real;
  • MLOps/DataOps aplicado a IA.


O que nós oferecemos


  • Descontos nas Universidades FIAP, FGV, EBAC, Impacta e Full Cycle
  • Parceria com a Open English e Cellep para aprimoramento do inglês
  • Oportunidade de realizar cursos e certificações
  • Apoio para participação em eventos de TI
  • Acesso a serviços de saúde e bem-estar através da nossa parceria com a Wellhub.

title: Engenheiro de Dados Sênior
description:
Atividades:

• Contribuir ativamente para a definição da arquitetura de dados (fontes, ingestão, armazenamento, acesso) e garantir o alinhamento com as políticas de TI e regras de negócio;

• Apoiar na definição de requisitos para a área de infraestrutura de TI/dados, com capacidade crítica em relação às soluções e alternativas propostas;

• Projetar e implementar arquiteturas de dados robustas e escaláveis, garantindo eficiência no processamento e armazenamento;

• Trabalhar estreitamente com outras equipes, antecipando necessidades e oferecendo suporte para garantir o sucesso dos projetos;

• Colaborar com a definição e extração dos dados de diversas fontes para ingestão nas plataformas de Big Data, bem como apoiar na criação e definição de estruturas para que os dados estejam apropriados, acessíveis e disponíveis zelando pelo alinhamento entre os dados operacionais e o modelo de dados requeridos;

• Contribuir com os projetos de Inteligência Artificial no que diz respeito à integração de dados e sistemas.

• Apoiar na arquitetura de soluções e manutenção dos sistemas.


Requisitos da vaga:

• Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Sistemas de Informação, Análise e Desenvolvimento de Sistemas e áreas afins;

• Conhecimento em gestão estratégica e gestão de projetos;

• Proficiência em Python para scripts de ETL, manipulação de dados e desenvolvimento de APIs (bibliotecas como Pandas, NumPy, PySpark);

• Atuação com Apache Spark, Flink e Kafka e desenvolvimento de workers eficientes;

• Conhecimento em infraestrutura de dados (Data Lake, Lakehouse, Data Warehouse, Big Data) e suas respectivas tecnologias;

• Domínio de SQL e experiência com bancos de dados relacionais e NoSQL;

• Conhecimento em DataOps e arquiteturas de dados, incluindo observabilidade;

• Aplicação de metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban).


Desejável:

• Pós-graduação e certificações na área de TI;

• Atuação relacionados a Dados;

• Atuação no setor financeiro;

• Atuação em empresas de grande porte no processamento de grandes volumes de dados;

• Atuação em projetos de MLOps/LLMOps e infraestrutura de deployment de modelos (inferência, monitoramento).

Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

Ei #fera , chegou o momento de encarar um novo desafio em sua carreira! Venha ser um #ferabrq !


No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia! É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.


Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.


O que procuramos?


Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!

- Mais de 4 anos de experiência em .NET nas versões atuais;

- Experiência em AWS ( Ec2, S3, SNS, SQS, Lambdas);

- Familiaridade com sistemas com muitas requisições e alta escalabilidade.

Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!


Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.


Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Home Office; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!

title: Content Writer
description:
Job Description:

We are seeking highly analytical and detail-oriented professionals with hands-on experience in Red Teaming, Prompt Evaluation , and AI/LLM Quality Assurance . The ideal candidate will help us rigorously test and evaluate AI-generated content to identify vulnerabilities, assess risks, and ensure compliance with safety, ethical, and quality standards.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Conduct Red Teaming exercises to identify adversarial, harmful, or unsafe outputs from large language models (LLMs).
  • Evaluate and stress-test AI prompts across multiple domains (e.g., finance, healthcare, security) to uncover potential failure modes.
  • Develop and apply test cases to assess accuracy, bias, toxicity, hallucinations , and misuse potential in AI-generated responses.
  • Collaborate with data scientists, safety researchers, and prompt engineers to report risks and suggest mitigations.
  • Perform manual QA and content validation across model versions, ensuring factual consistency, coherence, and guideline adherence.
  • Create evaluation frameworks and scoring rubrics for prompt performance and safety compliance.
  • Document findings, edge cases, and vulnerability reports with high clarity and structure.


Requirements:

  • Proven experience in AI red teaming , LLM safety testing, or adversarial prompt design.
  • Familiarity with prompt engineering , NLP tasks, and ethical considerations in generative AI.
  • Strong background in Quality Assurance , content review, or test case development for AI/ML systems.
  • Understanding of LLM behaviors, failure modes, and model evaluation metrics.
  • Excellent critical thinking, pattern recognition, and analytical writing skills.
  • Ability to work independently, follow detailed evaluation protocols, and meet tight deadlines.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Prior work with teams like OpenAI, Anthropic, Google DeepMind, or other LLM safety initiatives.
  • Experience in risk assessment, red team security testing, or AI policy & governance.

Background in linguistics, psychology, or computational ethics is a plus.


Next Steps

To proceed further in the evaluation process, you will need to complete two assessments:

  • Assessment Test
  • Evaluates your linguistic and analytical skills
  • Link:



  • Versant English Proficiency Test
  • Focuses on assessing your spoken and written English proficiency
  • A C1 or C2 level is required to qualify


Once both assessments are successfully completed, you will be eligible for onboarding.

  • Language test


Action Required: XConnect Registration

You will also receive an invitation to our internal job platform, XConnect . Please take a few minutes to register and complete your profile. All project onboarding, communication, and documentation are managed through this platform.


If interested, kindly share your resume at:

title: Bilingual Account Executive (Hunter/Closer)
description:
SaaS Sales for DatBot.ai & Flipbooker.com • Selling to the U.S. market • PJ contractor


Why this role: Short cycles, clear ICP, good conversion, and uncapped commission on cash collected with higher rates for self-sourced deals.


About us


We’re a lean U.S. SaaS company with products used by modern marketing teams. Engineering is in Brazil; sales targets the U.S. We value clear writing, fast experiments, and cash-in over vanity metrics.


Products


DatBot.ai – AI workflows for agencies/SMBs to research, brief, and ship content faster.


Flipbooker.com – Turns PDFs into branded, gated microsites with analytics and access control.


The role


Full-cycle AE (hunter). You’ll prospect, run tight discovery, do short narrative demos, and close straightforward Team+ deals. Self-serve stays on the websites; you own outbound and expansions.


ICP (who you’ll sell)


U.S. SMB/mid-market: Heads/VPs of Marketing, Demand Gen, Product Marketing, eComm Managers, RevOps in non-regulated industries. Natural cross-sell between products.


What you’ll do


Self-source 60–80% of pipeline via email/phone/LinkedIn + short Looms; re-engage warm leads fast.


Run discovery (why change / impact / timeline ≤90 days), do a 5–8 min demo, propose paid pilots, and close Team+ plans.


Build segmented lead lists and sequences; log clean notes; share weekly insights; surface cross-sell opportunities.


Drive a close plan on every late-stage opp (dates, owners, legal/security steps).


How we measure success (outcomes, not busywork)


Ramp:


Month 1 → 4–8 Qualified Meetings; 2–3 SAOs; 1 early win ideal.


Month 2 → 12–18 QMH; 6–8 SAOs; 1–3 wins.


Steady state (M3+): 12–20 QMH / 6–10 SAOs / 2–4 wins per month.


Cash-in: US$8k–$15k+/mo once ramped (grows as we dial in).


Quality gates we care about: Show ≥70% • Show→SAO 45–60% • SAO→Win 20–35%.


You’ll be great here if you have:


Excellent English (spoken/written) for U.S. prospect calls.


2+ years SaaS BDR/AE (U.S. SMB/mid-market a plus).


Real hunter chops: list building, smart personalization, tight copy, disciplined follow-up.


Tools: HubSpot, Apollo or similar, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Loom, Calendly, Google Workspace.


Compensation (uncapped, paid on cash collected)


Base (PJ): US$1.2k–1.8k/mo + 25–40% on cash collected for self-sourced Team+ (≥US$2k ARR), 10–20% on assisted, with accelerators. Biweekly payouts.

(Attribution and tiers shared after the intro call; standard clawbacks for early churn.)


Schedule: Remote in Brazil with ~3–4 hours overlap to U.S. ET/PT.

Engagement: PJ contractor.


Interview process


Intro screen: product pitch + quick funnel/OTE math.


Skills gauntlet: cold-call opener, discovery + 5–8 min narrative demo, objection/negotiation.


Deal deep-dive with optional paid micro-trial if mutually useful.


How to apply


Send your CV, your proudest prospecting/closing win (3–5 sentences with metrics), and:


A 90-second Loom pitching Flipbooker to a U.S. VP Marketing.


Two first-touch emails (one for DatBot.ai, one for Flipbooker) aimed at different ICPs.
